name: paracetamol (acetaminophen) form I, monoclinic P2_1/n, Z = 4 (COD 2104364, 100 K)
route: CIF route: COD 2104364 -> cif2lammps (X-H normalised to Allen & Bruno 2010, atoms relaxed in the CIF cell) -> ReaxFF-lg unit cell; level 2 through the chain's CIF-route surfenergy example
force_field: ReaxFF-lg (reax-lg-2011.ff, Liu, Liu, Zybin & Goddard 2011; in the private chain, not distributed here)
forcefield_note: ReaxFF-lg 2011 is parametrised for nitramine energetic crystals (RDX, HMX, PETN); it is not validated for hydrogen-bonded pharmaceuticals like paracetamol. Absolute gammas are uncertain: screening-level, the facet ranking is the usable result.
setting_note: Miller indices are relative to the data-file a, b, c (a = 7.0915 along x, b = 9.2149 along y, c = 11.6015 in xz; beta 97.865 deg): the COD cell, space group P2_1/n (No. 14, Hall -P 2yn; h0l absent for h + l odd, 0k0 for k odd). The paracetamol morphology literature mostly uses P2_1/a (a ~12.87, b ~9.40, c ~7.10 A, beta ~115.9 deg): convert with setting_map before using a paper's (hkl): h_n = -l_a, k_n = k_a, l_n = h_a + l_a (e.g. (1 1 0)_a -> (0 1 1)_n, (0 0 1)_a -> (-1 0 1)_n = {1 0 -1}, (2 0 -1)_a -> (1 0 1)_n). Check the paper's lattice parameters first: the map holds only for the P2_1/a cell.
spacegroup_data_setting: P2_1/n (No. 14; spglib prints the standard symbol P2_1/c)

setting_map.literature_setting: P 1 21/a 1 (No. 14), a ~12.87, b ~9.40, c ~7.10 A, beta ~115.9 deg (room temperature, Haisa et al. 1976 cell)
setting_map.basis_relation: a_n = -c_a, b_n = b_a, c_n = a_a + c_a (rows of M in terms of a_a, b_a, c_a)
setting_map.miller_rule: Miller indices transform like the basis vectors: (h k l)_n = M (h k l)_a; (h k l)_a = M^-1 (h k l)_n
setting_map.explicit: h_n = -l_a, k_n = k_a, l_n = h_a + l_a;  h_a = h_n + l_n, k_a = k_n, l_a = -h_n
setting_map.absences_check: P2_1/a h0l (h odd) -> P2_1/n h0l (h + l odd): OK
